setup_graph_parallel_groups: setup graph parallel and data parallel process groups for distributed training with a specified group size and backend
setup_gp: initialize graph parallel groups from a config dict containing gp_gpus and distributed_backend keys
reduce_from_model_parallel_region: reduce a tensor across the graph parallel region using all_reduce for distributed training
scatter_to_model_parallel_region: scatter a tensor across the graph parallel region by splitting along the first dimension
scale_backward_grad: scale backward gradients by the graph parallel world size to correct DDP mean reduction
